MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.

3. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

4. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

5. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.

6. When practising Reading for Understanding, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Understanding.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Understanding.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Understanding.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Understanding.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
